title: Settings
intro: Gateway key, extras, and defaults for the {workspaceName} desk. Other workspaces keep their own keys and setup. Paste your {gatewayName} API key from {gatewayHost} to use chat and job modes on this desk.
gatewayHelp: Paste your gateway API key for this desk. It never comes back after save.
saved: Saved. Keys stay on this desk.
privacy: Prompts leave this machine only over HTTPS to {gatewayHost}. {productName} does not log prompts. Keys and threads are encrypted on disk. {gatewayName} retention is the gateway's policy.
languageHelp: Applies after you restart DPSBuddy. Chat and job modes follow this language.
gateway.grace: Working offline with a key verified on {date}.
gateway.checkFailed: Could not re-check the gateway right now. Try again in a moment.
reset.heading: Start over
reset.help: Forget the gateway key on this machine, or delete everything and get the fresh-install experience back.
reset.signOutHelp: Forgets the saved key on every desk and sends you back to the first-run screen. Threads, desks, knowledge, and files stay.
reset.signOutConfirm: Sign out of the gateway? The saved key is forgotten on every desk and you will be asked for a key again. Nothing else is deleted.
reset.freshInstallHelp: Deletes every bit of local data and restarts {productName} on the first-run screen.
reset.freshInstallWarning: This deletes every thread, desk, knowledge base, generated image and video, and the saved gateway key on this machine. {productName} restarts on the first-run screen. This cannot be undone.
reset.restarting: {productName} is restarting. The reset finishes as it comes back up.
reset.restartNeeded: Restart {productName} to finish the reset. On the dev server, stop it and start it again.
reset.restartRefused: {productName} could not restart just now ({reason}). Close it and open it again to finish the reset.
reset.pending: A full reset is queued for the next launch.
reset.pendingCancelled: The queued reset is called off. Nothing will be deleted.
reset.failed: Could not finish that just now. Try again in a moment.
